title: Accounts Receivable
description:
CMA is supporting an established business in Portsmouth with the appointment of a part-time Accounts Receivable professional. Working 25 hours per week, this role offers flexibility around working days and hours, along with the opportunity to contribute to the smooth financial and front-of-house operation of the business.

What will the Accounts Receivable role involve?
- Supporting the effective management of incoming customer payments and receivables activity
- Helping maintain accurate financial records and ensuring transactions are processed promptly
- Assisting with queries and providing a professional point of contact when required
- Providing reception cover during lunch periods, supporting the day-to-day running of the office
- Working flexibly across an agreed 25-hour schedule

Suitable Candidate for the Accounts Receivable vacancy:
- Previous experience in accounts receivable, credit control or a similar finance position
- Confident handling financial information with a careful and organised approach
- Professional communication skills, with the ability to support both finance and reception activities
- Reliable, adaptable and comfortable working independently within a part-time arrangement

Additional benefits and information for the role of Accounts Receivable:
- Part-time working pattern of 25 hours per week
- Free parking

title: Experienced Bookkeeper
description:
Experienced Bookkeeper

Location: Portsmouth, Hampshire (modern office near Portsmouth)

Salary: £28,000 £32,000 per annum (depending on experience) + Benefits

Vacancy Type: Full-time, permanent

Join a forward-thinking firm where you can make an impact and grow your career.

About Morris Crocker

Established in 1890, Morris Crocker is an independent accountancy practice with around 100 people and eight Directors. We combine a proud heritage with a modern approach, using cloud-based systems, technology and continuous improvement to deliver excellent client service.

You'll join a friendly, professional team where collaboration, innovation and personal development are valued as the firm continues to grow.

Our Mission & Values

Our mission is to deliver excellence by putting our people at the heart of everything we do.

Our values are to:
- Deliver Excellence: Embrace modern technology and continually improve.
- Support & Collaborate: Create a friendly culture where everyone's contribution is valued.
- Learn & Grow: Take ownership of development and create opportunities for our clients, colleagues and the firm.

About the Role

As an Experienced Bookkeeper, you'll work closely with a Manager, supporting a varied client portfolio across different industries. You'll play an important role in maintaining accurate financial records, improving processes and helping clients make the most of modern accounting technology.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage bookkeeping and reporting for a varied client portfolio using cloud accounting software.
- Carry out scheduled monthly bookkeeping visits to client premises.
- Prepare VAT, CIS and Making Tax Digital returns.
- Maintain accurate ledgers, complete reconciliations and resolve discrepancies.
- Support the preparation of management accounts and annual financial statements.
- Identify manual or inefficient processes and help develop practical automation solutions.
- Help clients implement suitable accounting apps, improve system integration and strengthen financial reporting.
- Advise clients on cloud accounting, automation and digital tools.
- Collaborate with colleagues to improve internal processes and client services.

What We Offer

Development & Progression
- Regular one-to-one meetings and professional development reviews.
- Opportunities to specialise in particular industries or technical areas.
- Ongoing investment in technology, systems and modern working practices.

Benefits
- 37.5-hour working week with flexible start and finish times.
- 28 days' holiday, including statutory days.
- Bonus scheme linked to company performance.
- Pension with 3% employer contribution.
- Life assurance worth twice your salary.
- Summer and Christmas social events.
- Modern offices and a supportive, collaborative culture.

About You

You'll be a great fit if you:
- Are an experienced, confident and proactive bookkeeper with strong technical skills.
- Take ownership of your work and manage your workload effectively.
- Have excellent attention to detail and a practical, problem-solving approach.
- Have strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- Can work confidently with senior management and support colleagues.
- Have a full, clean driving licence and access to your own transport.
- Enjoy helping clients and contributing to a growing team.

Desirable, but not essential
- AAT Bookkeeping qualification.
- An interest in data, automation, AI or digital tools.
- Experience working in an accountancy practice.

Why Morris Crocker?

Join a growing firm that values your expertise, invests in your development and gives you the opportunity to take ownership of your work. You'll work with supportive colleagues, a varied client base and a leadership team committed to building a respected, ethical and people-focused business.

To Apply

Ready to take the next step in your accounting career? If you'd like to join Morris Crocker, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply today.

Previous applicants need not apply.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
CMA Recruitment Group is currently recruiting on behalf of a well-known business in Portsmouth, Hampshire for a Finance Assistant to join its finance processing team on a temporary, full-time basis for a period of 6 months. This is an opportunity to contribute to a high-volume finance function, supporting accurate banking, accounts payable and accounts receivable processes within a collaborative team environment. The business processes significant transaction volumes and offers a role with broad exposure across core finance operations.

What will the Finance Assistant role involve?
- Supporting the accurate processing and review of banking, supplier and customer transactions
- Completing regular bank reconciliations and investigating discrepancies to maintain reliable financial records
- Assisting with customer account administration, invoice production and the resolution of outstanding items
- Preparing payment information and supporting appropriate financial controls and approvals
- Contributing to balance sheet reconciliations, finance systems maintenance and continuous process accuracy

Suitable Candidate for the Finance Assistant vacancy:
- Previous experience in a high-volume finance assistant role
- Practical knowledge of reconciliations, transaction processing and ledger administration
- Strong attention to detail, with the judgement to investigate issues and escalate where appropriate
- Confident communication skills and the ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders

Additional benefits and information for the role of Finance Assistant:
- 6 month initial temporary assignment
- Free parking
- Hybrid working after training - 2 days in the office per week
- Salary will be dependent on experience.

title: Part Time Customer Service Advisor
description:
Customer Services /Incident Management Advisor
Permanent
Hours:24 Hours Per Week- Part Time
Salary: £17,600 per annum plus fantastic benefits
Location: Portsmouth

About the Role
Are you a naturally caring and empathetic person who enjoys helping others? Do you have excellent customer service skills and the ability to remain calm and professional in challenging situations?
We are looking for a Customer Service Advisor to work within a specialist operations team on a part time basis.

This is an important customer-focused role, supporting individuals following road traffic accidents. You will often be speaking to customers at what can be a difficult and stressful time, so being able to show empathy, patience and understanding is essential.

You will take ownership of incidents from the initial notification through to resolution, coordinating with customers, insurers, repairers and recovery providers to ensure everything runs as smoothly as possible.

As a part-time Customer Service Advisor your key responsibilities will include :
- Handling incoming accident notification calls and supporting customers with care and professionalism.
- Taking ownership of incidents from initial notification through to resolution.
- Arranging vehicle recovery where vehicles are no longer roadworthy.
- Coordinating vehicle repairs and selecting suitable repair locations.
- Liaising with customers, insurers and repairers to minimise vehicle downtime.
- Managing hire vehicle arrangements and associated administration.
- Processing total loss claims and monitoring their progress.
- Responding to customer enquiries by telephone and email.
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring timely follow-ups.
- Identifying opportunities to improve processes and customer experience.

About You
We are looking for someone who:
- Has previous experience in a customer service or customer support role.
- Is naturally empathetic, caring and understanding.
- Can remain calm and professional when dealing with potentially distressing situations.
- Has excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Has strong attention to detail and accurate data-entry skills.
- Is confident handling challenging conversations and resolving problems.
- Can manage a busy workload and competing priorities.
- Enjoys working as part of a team and supporting colleagues.

Previous experience in, insurance or accident management would be beneficial but isn't essential.

What's on Offer?
- Permanent, part-time employment.
- 24 hours per week, ideally spread across five days.
- Salary of £17,600 per annum.
- Full induction and comprehensive role-specific training.
- Ongoing coaching, feedback and development opportunities.
- A friendly and supportive team environment.

Important Information
Please note that all successful candidates will be required to undergo security clearance before commencing employment.

Interested?
If you are a compassionate, organised and customer-focused individual who enjoys making a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to find out more from Fran at the Dynamite team

title: Payroll officer / Clerk - Power/civil engineering
description:
We are looking for a reliable, organised and enthusiastic Payroll Officer to join a civil enigneering and Utilities contractor based in Portsmouth.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with payroll experience, strong attention to detail and a good understanding of payroll administration. The successful candidate will be responsible for paying employees and supply chain accurately and on time, and keeps the company compliant with HMRC on PAYE, CIS and VAT. The postholder prepares and processes; approval and release sit with the Financial Controller and authorised signatories.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing weekly and/or monthly payroll.
- Maintaining accurate employee records and payroll information.
- Processing new starters, leavers and changes to employee details.
- Checking timesheets, working hours, overtime and absences.
- Calculating wages, deductions, PAYE and National Insurance contributions.
- Administering pension contributions and statutory payments.
- Responding to payroll queries from employees in a professional and timely manner.
- Ensuring payroll deadlines are met and all information is processed accurately.
- Maintaining confidentiality of employee and payroll information.
- Providing general administrative support where required.

The Ideal Candidate
- Previous payroll experience is essential/preferred.
- Good understanding of payroll processes, PAYE and National Insurance.
- Experience using payroll software and Microsoft Excel.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong organisational and time-management skills.
- Ability to work to deadlines and manage competing priorities.
- A professional, approachable and helpful manner.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

What We Offer
- Competitive salary, dependent on experience.
- A friendly and supportive working environment.
- Opportunities for training and development.
- The opportunity to become part of an established team.

title: Payroll/Finance Assistant

This is an excellent opportunity to utilise your payroll expertise within a worthwhile organisation that is actively reviewing and enhancing its processes, systems and use of automation.

- Assist with general finance administration, including invoice queries, email responses and transactional duties during quieter payroll periods

Suitable Candidate for the temporary Payroll/Finance Assistant vacancy:
- Previous experience managing or coordinating payroll processes, ideally within a multi-site or complex environment
- A strong understanding of payroll data, timesheets, pensions and employee changes
- An analytical and improvement-focused approach, with the confidence to review established processes
- Comfortable working with payroll, HR and finance systems, including spreadsheets and reports
- Able to work independently while collaborating effectively with finance and HR colleagues

title: Private Client Legal Assistant
company: Clear Legal & Financial Recruitment - Agency - Permanent
description:
An opportunity has arisen for an organised and enthusiastic Legal Assistant to join a growing Private Client team based in Portsmouth.

The role will primarily involve supporting solicitors with matters relating to Wills and Lasting Powers of Attorney (LPAs). This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build a career in law, with full training and ongoing support provided.

Previous legal experience, particularly within Private Client, would be advantageous but is not essential. Applications are welcomed from candidates with strong administration skills, excellent attention to detail and a genuine interest in developing within a legal environment.

Key Responsibilities
- Assisting with taking instructions from clients.
- Preparing and drafting Wills and Lasting Powers of Attorney, with appropriate training and supervision.
- Supporting solicitors with the day-to-day management and progression of client matters.
- Preparing correspondence, legal documents and other administrative paperwork.
- Maintaining accurate and well-organised electronic and paper files.
- Liaising professionally with clients, professional referrers and third parties.
- Recording time spent on fee-earning and administrative tasks.
- Developing knowledge of relevant legislation, legal procedures and firm processes.
- Providing general administrative support to the Private Client Department.

Requirements
- A genuine interest in Private Client law and a willingness to learn.
- Previous experience in a legal or administrative role (advantageous but not essential).
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
- The ability to manage competing tasks and meet deadlines.
- Good IT skills, particularly Microsoft Word, Outlook and Excel.
- A professional, approachable and client-focused manner.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- A positive attitude and a good sense of humour.

Salary & Benefits
- Salary of £26,000 per annum, depending on experience.
- Ongoing training and development.
- Support to develop your legal knowledge and skills.
- Bonus scheme.
- Company pension.
- Company events and staff days out.
- Office closure over the Christmas period.

Should you have any questions or wish to apply please do not hesitate to contact Clear Legal and Financial.

Please Note: Due to the number of applications we receive we may be unable to respond to every application directly. If you have not heard from us within 3 working days please assume your application has been unsuccessful.

title: Service Receptionist (Automotive)
description:
Amour Recruitment are pleased to be recruiting for an experienced Customer Service Receptionist on behalf of our client based in Portsmouth. This is an exciting opportunity to join a well-established, family-run business specialising in the repair and maintenance of commercial vehicles and trailers. Working as part of a busy depot team, you'll be the first point of contact for customers, supporting workshop operations, coordinating service bookings and ensuring a first-class customer experience throughout every stage of the repair and servicing process. This is a varied and fast-paced role that would suit someone who thrives in a customer-facing environment, enjoys multitasking and takes pride in keeping things organised and running smoothly. Full training will be provided on company systems and processes. Responsibilities:
- Meeting and greeting customers in person, by telephone and email.
- Managing service bookings, scheduled servicing, MOT and tachograph appointments.
- Coordinating vehicle breakdowns and keeping customers updated throughout the process.
- Maintaining electronic job cards and workshop management systems.
- Liaising closely with workshop teams to monitor progress and communicate updates.
- Obtaining customer authorisations, preparing estimates and ensuring completed work is ready for invoicing.
- Processing completed jobs and forwarding documentation for payment.
- Receiving and allocating parts and consumables to relevant jobs.
- Monitoring courtesy vehicles and company vehicle usage.
- Providing administrative support to the workshop, service and parts departments.
- Supporting customer retention through excellent service and communication.

Requirements:
- Minimum 2 years' experience within the automotive industry.
- Previous experience within a service, reception or dealership environment.
- Excellent customer service and communication skills.
- Professional and confident telephone manner.
- Good IT skills and ability to learn new systems quickly.
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Ability to prioritise workload and remain calm in a busy environment.
- Proactive and positive approach to work.
- A genuine desire to build a long-term career within the automotive sector.

Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00am - 6:00pm (30-minute unpaid lunch break)
Every third Saturday, 8:00am - 12:00pm
Flexible start and finish times may be considered. Salary: £28,000 to £32,000 DOE Benefits:
- 28 days annual leave including bank holidays.
- Enhanced annual leave with length of service.
- NEST Pension Scheme.
- Ongoing training and development opportunities.
- Additional benefits available after 12 months' service, subject to eligibility.

If you're an experienced customer service professional with automotive industry experience and are looking to join a growing business that genuinely values its employees, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply today and the Amour Recruitment team will be in touch.

title: Shipping Coordinator
description:
Shipping Coordinator

Location: Portsmouth
Salary: Up to 37,000 DOE
Hours: 30-40 hours per week
Benefits: 28 days holiday, free parking and a friendly, family-owned working environment

What's on Offer?
- Salary of up to 37,000, depending on experience.
- Flexible working hours of 30-40 hours per week.
- 28 days' holiday.
- Free on-site parking.
- A friendly, supportive and family-owned working environment.
- A varied role with responsibility across the international supply chain.
- The opportunity to work with overseas manufacturers and established retail customers.

The Opportunity

We're working with an established, family-owned business in Portsmouth that supplies products to major retailers across the UK and international markets.

With overseas manufacturing and a growing international customer base, they're looking for an experienced Shipping Coordinator to manage orders from factory production through to international shipment and final delivery.

This is a varied, hands-on role combining international shipping, factory coordination, production tracking and order management. It's an excellent opportunity for someone who understands the challenges of overseas manufacturing and enjoys keeping shipments, suppliers and deadlines on track.

Key Responsibilities
- Factory & Production Coordination: Liaise with overseas manufacturers to confirm purchase orders, monitor production schedules and ensure goods are ready for shipment on time.
- International Shipping: Coordinate shipments from China to the UK and international markets, managing FOB arrangements, freight bookings and delivery schedules.
- Shipping Documentation: Prepare and check commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading and other relevant shipping and customs documentation.
- Freight & Customs: Obtain freight quotations, liaise with freight forwarders and customs agents, and coordinate import clearance and onward deliveries where required.
- Order Management: Track production progress, cargo-ready dates and goods in transit, keeping internal teams informed of any changes or delays.
- Costs & Invoicing: Check supplier and freight invoices, resolve discrepancies and help minimise unnecessary shipping and storage costs.
- Systems & Administration: Maintain accurate order and shipment records using Excel and ERP systems, ensuring deadlines and outstanding actions are monitored.
- Problem Solving: Identify potential delays, coordinate solutions with suppliers and logistics partners, and help improve existing processes.

About You
- Previous experience in international shipping and coordinating orders with overseas manufacturers, ideally in China.
- Good understanding of FOB shipping arrangements and international shipping documentation.
- Experience tracking production schedules, monitoring factory progress and managing cargo-ready dates.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple shipments and deadlines.
- Confident communicating with suppliers, freight forwarders, customers and internal teams.
- Good Excel skills and experience using an ERP or order-management system.
- A proactive, hands-on approach to resolving problems and preventing delays.
- Experience with UK customs procedures, consumer goods or major retailers would be advantageous.

Interested?

If you have experience in international shipping, overseas supplier coordination and production tracking, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to find out more about this opportunity.

title: Vehicle Support Coordinator
description:
Vehicle Support Coordinator - Part Time (24 hours per week)

Location: Portsmouth

Hours: 24 hours per week, ideally spread across 5 days, (mornings are preferred)

Job Type: Permanent

We're looking for a friendly and organised person to join our client's Operations team and support customers when things don't quite go to plan with their vehicle.

This team looks after every stage of the vehicle journey, helping to keep vehicles on the road and supporting customers when issues arise. The focus of the team is to make things easy for customers, providing support, practical solutions and peace of mind whenever they need it.

Key Responsibilities:
- Taking incoming calls from customers following vehicle accidents
- Providing reassurance, empathy and practical support
- Arranging vehicle recoveries where required
- Liaising with repairers, insurers and customers
- Managing repair progress and minimising vehicle downtime
- Handling customer queries by phone and email
- Supporting the administration of accident and insurance claims
- Maintaining accurate records and updating systems

What We're Looking For:
- Previous customer service experience
- Strong communication and listening skills
- A calm and empathetic approach, particularly when dealing with distressed or vulnerable customers
- Excellent attention to detail
- Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks
- A proactive mindset
- Experience working to targets, KPIs or service levels would be beneficial

What's on Offer:
- Hybrid working to support a healthy work/life balance
- Full training and ongoing support to help you succeed in the role
- Friendly, supportive team with a collaborative working culture
- Opportunities to learn new skills and develop your career
- A range of additional company benefits

Important Information
